prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Secure Your Pet to the Cloud", "Sign in so your pet, progress, and custom items are saved safely and accessible from any desktop.", "Cloud Save Protected", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
1: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Select a starter pet or design your own custom desktop companion.", "Choose Species"]
2: []
3: ["Welcome Home!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop status bar."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace...", "We are generating high-res animations and desktop behaviors.", "Did you know? Double clicking your pet brings up the quick menu."]
5: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos for best 3D pet rendering results.", "Best Results: Clear lighting & full face"]
6: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Pick a ready-to-play companion in seconds, or craft a custom pet from photos.", "You can always customize your pet later in settings."]
7: ["Make sure to sign in with the same email you used previously to keep your pets."]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize adoption!", "Pet Name"]
9: ["Onboarding Complete! Claim Your Starter Toy Pack", "Your companion is ready on your screen. Enjoy 3 free desktop interactive toys!", "Unlocked: Golden Ball & Cozy Bed", "Meet Pet on Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for photos of the user's face, which is personal information.
Mentions free extras and promotional gifts.
